key_insight: A hybrid wave-mode formulation combines local modal reduction with propagating-wave reduction to lower the cost of dispersion analysis in 2D periodic structures.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports efficient vibration and wave-propagation analysis of structurally realistic periodic panels.
method: Use Wave Finite Element modeling with Floquet–Bloch periodicity.
Apply Component Mode Synthesis to represent unit-cell local resonances.
Project the wave spectral problem onto a reduced set of propagating-wave shape functions.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an application to a bi-directionally stiffened panel, examining reduction-parameter effects and numerical robustness, but gives no quantitative speedup or error metrics.
watch_item: Reduced-basis selection must preserve relevant local resonances and propagating waves; reduction-parameter sensitivity warrants checking.
paper_title: A hybrid wave-mode formulation for the vibro-acoustic analysis of 2D periodic structures
